test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Kishori Amonkar, one of the finest classical singers of Hindustani music, was from which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kishori Amonkar** was a renowned classical singer of Hindustani music.
 
• She was born on **10 April 1932** in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• Kishori Amonkar was a prominent figure in the **Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana** tradition of Indian classical music.
 
• She was known for her **innovative and emotional interpretations** of classical compositions.
 
• Amonkar received several prestigious awards, including the **Padma Bhushan (1987)** and **Padma Vibhushan (2002)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindustani Classical Music**

 
 
• One of the two main forms of Indian classical music, the other being Carnatic music.
 
• It originated in North India and is known for its complex ragas (melodic frameworks) and talas (rhythmic cycles).
 
• Prominent gharanas (musical schools) include Jaipur-Atrauli, Gwalior, and Kirana.
 
 
 
• **Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana**
 
 
• Founded by Alladiya Khan in the late 19th century.
 
• Known for its intricate and elaborate raga structures.
 
• Emphasizes on the purity of notes and complex taans (rapid melodic sequences).
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards**
 
 
• One of the highest civilian honors in India.
 
• Conferred in three categories: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• Awards are given for distinguished service in various fields such as arts, science, and public affairs.
 
 
 
• **Classical Music Awards**
 
 
• Various organizations and governments confer awards to recognize excellence in classical music.
 
• Some notable awards include the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and the Tansen Award.
